text:
alex: Quick check-in — I uploaded a PRD draft for the "Generation API: edge scenarios" work. Link: https://drive.redwood/edge-scenarios-prd. Need alignment on launch scope, acceptance criteria, and who owns which edge cases. Please skim and call out must-haves by EOD tomorrow.

maria: Link opened. Which customers are driving this? Any enterprise legal/compliance must-haves we should call out now?

alex: Primary asks from PaymentsApp and HealthCo + a few internal platform teams. Immediate enterprise asks: (1) deterministic retries without duplicate sideeffects, (2) explicit truncation reasons for audit, (3) ability to resume streams for flaky mobile networks.

jordan: Draft acceptance criteria strawman:
- Streaming resume: client can reconnect with a resume token and continue without producing duplicate user-visible tokens (at-most-once semantics) in >=99.5% of reconnects within 5s.
- Truncation reporting: when generation stops early (token limit, safety, user stop), we return a machine-readable reason code and a human summary.
- Token-limit errors: responses include remaining token estimate and clear `retryable` flag.
- Retry safety: 5xx retries allowed only if idempotency-token present; server dedup TTL defined.

shiv: Enumerating tricky edge cases we should explicitly call out in the PRD/spreadsheet:
- Partial UTF-8 / token boundary splits on reconnects causing garbled last token.
- Client reconnect that replays the final N bytes -> duplicate last token visible.
- Function/tool-calling mid-stream: what does resume semantics look like if `function_call` triggered but not completed before disconnect?
- Truncation due to safety filter vs token cap: clients need different UI/telemetry behaviors.
- Rate-limit triggered partial streams (client gets part of response then 429) and subsequent retry flow.
- Model-variant length mismatch: quantized vs fp model count tokens differently; resume tokens may mismatch if fallback happened.
- Streaming with inline embeddings (hybrid payloads) and reconnect semantics.
- Prefix/KV cache mismatches for resumed requests where routing fell back to alternative model.

kevin: This list is huge. We should triage. My recommendation:
- GA must: idempotent retry semantics, truncation reason codes, basic resume token that covers common mobile reconnects.
- Post-GA: function-call resume, cross-model resume reconciliation, per-token billing reconciliation, advanced safety-resume policies.

sam: Prioritization proposal (Must / Should / Nice-to-have):
Must: idempotent retry handle, explicit reason codes for cutoff, consistent final newline/token semantics.
Should: resume tokens (opaque), token-remaining estimates, basic client SDK helpers.
Nice-to-have: full function-call resume, cross-model cache reconciliation, multi-device transferable resume tokens.

maria: Also need test plan acceptance: fuzz tests for corrupted token boundaries, network flakiness harness (random disconnects at N ms), cross-client integration tests (js/python/sdk) to validate resume/dedup behavior. Add logs/metric requirements: resumed_count, resume_success_rate, duplicate_token_rate, truncation_reason_breakdown.

alex: Love these. Add a few numeric targets into PRD:
- Resume success rate >= 99.5% for reconnects within 5s on simulated mobile network.
- Truncation false-positive (claiming cut-off when full) < 0.1% on corpus.
- Duplicate-token incidents <= 1 per 10k resumptions.
- Documentation and SDK feature parity before GA.

jordan: Small decision callout: dedup window semantics. Propose server-side dedup using `idempotency-token` + `sequence-id` TTL = 24h. That allows retries across connectivity blips but bounds storage.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PRD draft file created in /product/roadmap/prds/edge-scenarios-prd-v1.md, label `edge-scenarios` added.

shiv: Open UX/semantic question: should resume token be opaque or client-inspectable? My vote: opaque token to avoid leaking internal KV/cache state. But customers want cross-device resume.

alex: Compromise: opaque token format, but document an allowed transfer mechanism: clients can pass the same resume token from device A to B if user authorizes it. We will not expose internal fields in the token.

kevin: OK. I'll own the scope/triage sheet and the GA vs post-GA cut. Kickoff sync Friday 10:00am PT. Action items: Kevin -> prioritization sheet; Maria -> test/integration plan; Jordan -> formal acceptance criteria write-up; Shiv -> enumerate edge cases in spreadsheet; Alex -> update PRD and ping legal for HealthCo compliance items.

alex: Thanks all. I'll post an updated PRD + a short TL;DR for PM and sales tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks — added to my calendar for review. 

sam: Thanks, will prepare SDK notes for resume helper functions.

kevin: Noted. See you Friday.
